svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: September costs for three grades
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. Horizontal bars for a September total at grade 2, grade 6, and grade 9. The totals are $155, $240, and $495. Supplies, an optional fee, lunches, a device, and activities are inside those totals. Not a school invoice.
svg.text: Example with made-up inputs: a September total
Three made-up grades. Clothing is not in these bars. See the clothing guide.
Grade 2 is supplies, September lunches, and a small activity. No device.
Grade 6 adds a made-up optional trip fee of $40. It is not a required Ontario fee.
Grade 9 adds a made-up $250 device the household chose. Ask the school before you buy one.
Ontario's guideline: no fees for required learning. Hardship policies must be discreet.
Other provinces: check the province. Do not copy Ontario's rule.
Saving Optimizer. Example with made-up inputs. Checked 29 Sep 2026.
